# microwave_body articulation audit

Status: **repaired simulation geometry; strict physical audit FAIL / evidence unavailable**. This file supersedes the prior Round 2 notes, saved under `../review/artcheck_before/microwave_body/notes.md`.

Separated door/gasket from fascia and chassis; added a pushbar bezel and top reveal; aligned control planes; separated tray from hub. GLB previously omitted evaluated modifiers (bevels/weighted geometry); export now applies them and matches the OBJ mesh. Joint names, textures, mechanism controllers and metric travel ranges are preserved. Added local front `[0,-1,0]`, preferred azimuth -90°, elevation 20°, and a standard root `model.xml`.

The world pose and envelope were refined with original calibrated cameras and fixed support height. Current origin: [0.8238195865599842, -1.2105140310817626, 0.985]; yaw 180.647492°. Size [0.579366, 0.389115, 0.342027] m. No pitch/roll tilt was introduced. Camera matrices and K match Scene exactly.

Rest geometry numbers (model measurements, not physical certification):

- `microwave_front_door`: tilt 0.000000°, face/rim offset 0.000 mm, maximum seam/radial clearance 2.692 mm; PASS.
- `turntable_rotation`: tilt 0.000000°, face/rim offset 0.000 mm, maximum seam/radial clearance 0.482 mm; PASS.
- `release_press`: tilt 0.000000°, face/rim offset 2.677 mm, maximum seam/radial clearance 0.963 mm; PASS.

Ten samples per joint plus independent hinge/button combinations show no penetrating MuJoCo self contacts; parent filtering is disabled. Detailed visual triangle sweeps also pass. Contact-driven release, opening and closing/re-latch tests pass. MuJoCo ground contact has micrometre-scale solver penetration; this is reported separately from self-intersection. The full numeric logs are in `../review/artcheck/`.

Closed-state calibrated edges (native 1280×1707, maximum bidirectional external-boundary distance; masks exclude independently traced occluders):

- `f0299`: max 21.02 px, p95 11.01 px, depth-converted max 17.60 mm; FAIL.
- `f0305`: max 24.00 px, p95 13.00 px, depth-converted max 19.40 mm; FAIL.
- `f0321`: max 23.00 px, p95 22.00 px, depth-converted max 15.93 mm; FAIL.
- `f0340`: max 25.00 px, p95 21.54 px, depth-converted max 13.55 mm; FAIL.

[Photo / q=0 render / overlay](../review/artcheck_microwave_body.jpg). Whole-body and independent moving-edge errors are both in `../artcheck_report.json`. The microwave f0340 reference outline was corrected from the original photo because the old trace included a countertop triangle under the door. Annotation uncertainty is 3–8 px; thresholds were not relaxed.

The 232.98 s source was scanned at 2 s intervals, supplemented by calibrated close-up crops. The inventory explicitly says neither appliance was opened. `articulation.json` contains only an inferred microwave hinge with an empty opening map; the corresponding splat joint has no states, and the cooker is absent. No actuated frames were found for any of the five joints. Therefore exact physical pivot/axis error, physical stop and observed maximum cannot be measured, and the mandatory two-actuated-frame test cannot pass. No invented observed q or fabricated evidence is used. Synthetic sweep images are simulation previews only.

Remaining physical parameters (mass, friction, spring torque, hidden cavity/pot/tray, stops) remain prior estimates. The body is rigid; elastic seals/feet are rigid contact proxies. Some photo edge residuals remain above 10 px under the required upright geometry and fixed calibration. Full physical sign-off needs calibrated opening and button-press observations plus stop/hinge measurements. No completion marker is appended because not all checks pass.

Reproduce with CPU only: `nice -n 19 taskset -c 16-19 blender -b -t 4 -P <asset>/build.py -- --skip-render`, then `review/build_simulation.py`, `review/artcheck_physics.py`, `review/artcheck_exports.py`, `review/artcheck_visual.py`, `review/test_dynamics.py`, `review/test_contact_press.py`, calibrated renders and `review/artcheck_report.py`. Python uses `[source workspace]`, from `[source workspace]`, with `PYTHONPATH=.`. The report generator rejects absent rendered evidence. No other asset set was edited.

[Synthetic joint sweeps](../review/artcheck_microwave_body_sweep.jpg) show the full exported ranges. These are not observed-state evidence.
